name: Commerce Profile Inline Form Radios
description: Alternative Drupal Commerce customer-profile inline form that renders the customer's own saved address-book profiles as radio buttons (instead of the default select dropdown) so returning customers pick an existing billing/shipping address with one click. Ships shipping, payment and paypal submodules that override the matching checkout panes/forms to use it. Selectable options are scoped to the current customer's own profiles.
project_description:
Provides an alternative customer profile inline form rendering address book profiles as radio buttons. 

Submodules shipping and payment provide alternative checkout panes for Commerce Shipping and Commerce Payment using the parent module's inline form.
